title: SAIR Inverse Galois
status_verified_2026_10_17: IGP24 June-August round finished; fall Stage 2 announced but concrete new rules not verified
run_mode: local/read-only discovery; no accounts, submissions, network services or paid computation
useful_smaller_deliverable: An explicit degree-24 polynomial certificate package: irreducibility, real-root signature, factorization evidence and correctly distinguished polynomial/field discriminants.
prerequisite_barrier: Finite-prime factorization patterns constrain but need not identify a Galois group. Full identification uses more group/resolvent machinery; polynomial discriminant can differ by an index square from the field discriminant. Magma access may be a prerequisite.
diagnostic_task: Pin a single published example polynomial and old-round evaluator. Recompute exact discriminant and Sturm real-root count using already installed algebra tools, then identify the missing group certificate. First recheck whether new Stage 2 rules have been published; do not reuse expired entry terms as current.
success_artifact: result.json containing exact statement/inputs, source revision and hashes, commands, output, proof/checker status, negative results, remaining bridge and elapsed seconds
decision_gate: Proceed only with a stated missing group/signature target, live rules if competition participation is intended, and reproducible group identification. Do not spend a slot on licensed-tool installation.
publication_and_novelty_limit: New small-discriminant fields or a reusable independently checkable group-certificate bridge can be meaningful. Replaying a known polynomial is setup, not a new realization.
forbidden_inferences: A timeout or no route found does not imply impossibility.
Finite tests are not a universal conjecture proof.
A local pass is not competition acceptance, novelty, payout or publication acceptance.
